comment: The Hem command (mitcad#2112; tools/ui-sheet-hem-test.sh and its Windows and macOS twins): sheet rules F1 (t = 2, r = 3, K = 0.3, back reference), Sketch1 F2 with a 35 x 20 rectangle at x = -30..5, y = 0..20, and the sheet Face F3 (F3.b0) on it; the side face at x = 5 is free for a hem. The volumes of the hems on it are those of cli.sheet_hem_forms.
